search_text:
$\left(\frac1y\sin\frac xy-\frac y{x^2}\cos\frac yx+1\right)dx+\left(\frac1x\cos\frac yx-\frac x{y^2}\sin\frac xy+\frac1{y^2}\right)dy=0$ 的通解为（ ） $\sin\frac xy-\cos\frac xy+x-\frac1y=C$ $\sin\frac yx-\cos\frac yx+x-\frac1y=0$ $\sin\frac yx-\cos\frac xy+x-\frac1y=C$ $\sin\frac yx-\cos\frac xy+y-\frac1x=0$ 方程整理为

$$\left(\frac{1}{y}\sin\frac{x}{y}\,dx-\frac{x}{y^2}\sin\frac{x}{y}\,dy\right)+\left(\frac{y}{x^2}\cos\frac{y}{x}\,dx+\frac{1}{x}\cos\frac{y}{x}\,dy\right)+dx+\frac{1}{y^2}dy=0,$$

$$-d\cos\frac{x}{y}+d\sin\frac{y}{x}+dx-d\left(\frac{1}{y}\right)=0,$$

即 $d\left(-\cos\frac{x}{y}+\sin\frac{y}{x}+x-\frac{1}{y}\right)=0$
